author: claude-opus-5-5
comparison: Rejected drawing drew four straight-edged triangle wings crossing in an X and squeezed the eyes into a tiny blob, reading as an asterisk or bow tie; the original has two large round eyes, four long wings spread from the thorax and a long thin tail.
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px light/dark. Two large round eyes, a long body/tail, long forewings sweeping up and shorter hindwings angled down; the dragonfly silhouette reads at 48. Lens-wing and open-loop variants kept in attempts/.
omissions: Wing outlines (four closed wings need ~42 units of height at the spacing rules; drawn as strokes) and the thorax capsule.
